infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Jodha Driver requires your location while using the app to guide you to delivery sites and communicate status to dispatch.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Continuous background location is required to provide accurate customer ETAs and satisfy NHVR safety compliance while on duty.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Camera access is needed to capture delivery proof photos, customer dockets, and vehicle defect reports.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Photo library access is needed to select delivery proof images.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow Jodha Driver to use your location in the background for active delivery route tracking.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow Jodha Driver to access your camera to take delivery proof photos.
